# `files` — `/api/community`

The file bank: each space's shared files and folders, kept on this server.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-files) | Space member | A folder of the space's files (or its trash), with the room used and the size limits. |
| PUT | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}`](#put-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid) | Space member | Renames, or moves to another folder; a folder takes everything in it along. |
| DELETE | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}`](#delete-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid) | Space member | Moves a file, or a folder with everything in it, to the trash. |
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/content`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-content) | Space member | A file's content, or an older version's, to download or (inline) to view. |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/restore`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-restore) | Space member | Restores something from the trash: whoever added it, or a space owner. |
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/versions`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-versions) | Space member | A file's versions, newest first. |
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/zip`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-zip) | Space member | A folder and everything in it, as one .zip: how a website leaves the Grove for its host. |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/folders`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-folders) | Space member | Creates a folder. |
| DELETE | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/trash/{fid}`](#delete-api-community-spaces-sid-trash-fid) | Space owner | Deletes something in the trash for good. |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/uploads`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-uploads) | Space member | Starts uploading a file, or a new version of one, after checking its size against the space's room and the server's free space. |
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/uploads/{uid}`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-uploads-uid) | Space member | How much of an upload has arrived, to resume it. |
| PUT | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/uploads/{uid}`](#put-api-community-spaces-sid-uploads-uid) | Member | One piece of an upload, at most 8 MB, at the given offset; the request body is the bytes. |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/uploads/{uid}/finish`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-uploads-uid-finish) | Space member | Completes an upload once every byte has arrived, adding the file or its new version. |

<a id="get-api-community-spaces-sid-files"></a>
### `GET /api/community/spaces/{sid}/files`

A folder of the space's files (or its trash), with the room used and the size limits.

- Handler: [`files`](../../../backend/community/files.py)
- Who may call: Members of the space

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sid` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `folder` | query | string | no | `""` |  |
| `trash` | query | boolean | no | `false` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `folder`, `items` (JSON list of rows of `files`: `id`, `folder`, `name`, `kind`, `size`, `version`, `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, `author_id`, `author`, `updated_by`), `used`, `limit`, `file_limit`

|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 404 | Folder not found. | `files` |

| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |

<a id="post-api-community-spaces-sid-uploads"></a>
### `POST /api/community/spaces/{sid}/uploads`

Starts uploading a file, or a new version of one, after checking its size against the space's room and the server's free space. The file then goes up in pieces.

- Handler: [`start_upload`](../../../backend/community/files.py)
- Who may call: Members of the space

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sid` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `UploadBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `folder` | string | no | `""` | at most 4200 characters |
| `name` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 200 characters |
| `size` | integer | yes |  | ≥ 0 |
| `replaces` | string or null | no |  | at most 64 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with `id`, `chunk`, `received`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters change website files. | `may_change_website` |
| 404 | File not found. | `live_item` |
| 404 | Folder not found. | `start_upload` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 409 | Something named {name} is already here. | `taken` |
| 413 | Files can be up to {file_limit() // MB} MB here. | `start_upload` |
| 413 | This space has room for {max(room, 0) / MB} MB more. Delete something, or ask the host for more room. | `start_upload` |
| 422 | Folders go 20 deep at most. | `clean_folder` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |
| 507 | The server is nearly out of space. Tell the host. | `start_upload` |
